_readme: 360 FASHION MAZE GAME — LingBot World 2 scene registry. One layered scene per maze section. Compose at runtime: prompt = base + camera[isMoving] + movement[isMoving] + heldEvents + vertical. Player POV is first-person (the blogger's own camera). seedImage lists the project photo(s) to use as the reference image (already 16:9, matches 1664x960); seedImagePrompt is provided only where a photo must be generated. Events are hold-keys: 1 = Pose Shift, 2 = Runway Circle, 3 = Group Pose (photo moment — app grants bonus points if P captures during this hold). Timer, coins, photo capture, score, and the maze graph are app-side, never prompted.

scenes.name: Neon Mirror Atrium
scenes.base: Five fashion models of diverse Black, Asian and Middle Eastern heritage in sculptural metallic couture — a central model with locs in a ribbed silver-blue jacket, flanked by hooded figures in iridescent navy coats and a flowing silver gown — inside a vast mirrored cyberpunk atrium. The world contains EXACTLY ONE ring of glowing yellow neon halos suspended overhead at a fixed position AND EXACTLY TWO mirrored corridor walls receding left and right at fixed positions. Violet and magenta neon columns, reflective patterned floor. Cinematic cyberpunk editorial, high gloss.

camera.static: First-person view, the five models holding steady at the centre of the frame at constant size and distance. Neither the models nor the camera moves on its own; arrow-key look-input is the only source of camera motion, panning the view across the stationary, centred models only while held.
camera.dynamic: Strict first-person view, the five models holding steady at the centre of the frame as the viewpoint advances through the mirrored corridor toward them; look-input becomes the heading changing.

movement.static: The five models hold their formation on the reflective floor, fabric shimmering faintly under the neon, the central model's chest rising with slow breaths, the hooded figures' coats settling in the still air.
movement.dynamic: The viewpoint glides forward along the reflective patterned floor at a steady walking pace, mirrored walls and violet neon columns sliding past on both sides, reflections scrolling smoothly underfoot, the five models growing gradually nearer.

events.name: Pose Shift
events.detail: The five models flow into a new editorial stance — hips angled, chins lifted, one hand raised — their metallic fabrics catching violet light as they settle and hold.

events.name: Runway Circle
events.detail: One by one the models step out and trace a small slow circle on the reflective floor, each garment turning through the neon glow, before rejoining the line and settling still.

events.name: Group Pose
events.detail: The five models draw together into a tight triangular formation, the central model front and centre, all faces toward the viewer, holding perfectly poised under the yellow halos.

vertical.jump: The viewpoint springs upward in a quick smooth arc, rising above the reflective floor before dropping back down and settling level at walking height.
vertical.crouch: The camera lowers toward the ground as the viewpoint crouches down low, the mirrored hall rising in frame.
vertical.stand: The viewpoint straightens back up out of the crouch, the camera rising smoothly to standing height.

scenes.seedImagePrompt: A first-person front-row still frame of a mirror-flat water runway between tall white stone pillars in a vast dark arena, a fashion model in sculptural couture walking on the water's surface toward the viewer with ripples spreading from each step, packed fashionable audience rising in tiers on both sides, cool blue spotlights and thin mist over the water, 16:9 landscape, photorealistic cinematic runway spectacle.
scenes.base: A grand finale fashion show on a mirror-flat water runway between tall white stone pillars in a vast dark arena, a couture model walking on the water's surface, ripples spreading from each step. The world contains EXACTLY ONE straight water runway at a fixed position ahead AND EXACTLY TWO tiered banks of seated fashionable audience at fixed positions left and right. Cool blue spotlights, thin mist over the water. Spectacular cinematic runway, awe-struck.

camera.static: First-person view from the front row, the runway holding steady at the centre of the frame at constant size and distance. Neither the runway nor the camera moves on its own; arrow-key look-input is the only source of camera motion, panning the view across the stationary, centred runway only while held.
camera.dynamic: Strict first-person view, the runway holding steady at the centre of the frame as the viewpoint drifts slowly along the front row beside it; look-input becomes the heading changing.

movement.static: The model walks the water runway in long even strides toward the viewer, ripples fanning from each footfall, the audience utterly rapt, mist curling in the spotlight beams.
movement.dynamic: The viewpoint drifts slowly along the front row at a gentle pace, the water runway gliding past alongside, seated audience streaming by, the walking model holding the spotlight.

events.name: Look Change — Afrofuturist Gold
events.detail: The spotlights sweep from cool blue to molten gold as a new model in radiant Afrofuturist metallic couture strides onto the water, the pillars and mist re-lit in amber around the unchanged runway.

events.name: Look Change — Op-Art White
events.detail: The spotlights snap to brilliant white as a new model in a black-and-white op-art gown strides onto the water, the pillars and audience re-lit in stark monochrome around the unchanged runway.

events.name: Look Change — Sequin Rose
events.detail: The spotlights melt to saturated pink as a new model in a glittering rose sequined suit strides onto the water, sequin light scattering across the ripples around the unchanged runway.

events.name: Water Spectacle
events.detail: Slender columns of illuminated water rise one by one from either side of the runway, arcing and falling back in sequence, staged clear of the model's path, droplets glittering in the beams.

events.name: Sky Installation
events.detail: The runway and audience remain the main scene, unchanged, while a huge sculptural chandelier of woven light lowers slowly from the darkness above the far end of the runway and holds.

events.name: Fireworks Finale (WIN)
events.detail: Fireworks burst high above the arena in gold and magenta one after another, their reflections blooming across the water runway, drifting sparks fading in the spotlight beams as every look holds for the final frame.

vertical.jump: The viewpoint rises briefly in a quick smooth arc, lifting above the front row before settling back down level at seated height.
vertical.crouch: The camera lowers as the viewpoint sinks low in the seat, the runway rising in frame.
vertical.stand: The viewpoint rises smoothly back up to seated height, the runway settling level in frame.
